topic: Target-date funds are great inside a 401k and quietly tax-inefficient in a regular brokerage account
title: Your Target-Date Fund Has a Hidden Tax Bill
description:
The most popular 'set it and forget it' investment has a quiet downside when used in the wrong type of account. We explain the tax trap inside target-date funds that most investors miss.
